newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Estee Lauder cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Estee Lauder cut.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities analyst Heather Hay said she cut her rating on Estee Lauder Cos Inc to hold from buy based on current valuation levels.
-- Estee Lauder's stock, priced at $38 on July 31, 1996 and $35 on January 2, 1996, has returned 23.0 percent and 33.6 percent since these dates, respectively," she said in a research note.

"This has substantially outperformed the market, which in the same time periods has returned 2.1 percent and 6.9 percent since these respective dates. Given Estee Lauder's already strong performance this year, in our view, the upside potential has diminished in the near term."
